facts.statement: Vusala's real pets were scared off by the graveyard, and the ghost pets that remain are the ones players can help her with. Players are asked to find all of Vusala's missing pets, after which they can adopt a ghost pet.
facts.quote: Talk to Vusala and see if you can find her missing pets before Sal Monella gets his dirty hands on them.

article_summaries.title: Explore the Blackspore Pet Adoption Center
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news post (page chrome in French, article text in English) describing the Blackspore Pet Adoption Center, run by Vusala, whose pets are all ghosts because of a nearby graveyard. Players are asked to find Vusala's missing pets before Sal Monella gets them, then may adopt a ghost pet. The post gives only a relative date ('1 year ago'), so no absolute publication date can be recorded.
